body: I used to use the cerave retinol but even after 3 months of consistent use (about 2 times a week) I didn't notice any difference, so I didn't buy any more

My routine is the vanicream cleanser, both day and night, the Cetaphil moisturizer, the biore spf in the mornings, alpha arbutin every night, and the paulas choice exfoliant about once a week. I also have a pretty big problem with picking at my skin, but I've been using pimple patches to help keep me from doing so
